from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
A = 0x40
i2c.writeto_mem(A, 0x00, b'\x10')  # sleep to set the prescaler
i2c.writeto_mem(A, 0xFE, bytes([121]))  # 50 Hz for servos
i2c.writeto_mem(A, 0x00, b'\xa0')  # wake, auto-increment
def pulse(ch, us):
    off = int(us * 4096 / 20000)
    i2c.writeto_mem(A, 0x06 + 4 * ch, bytes([0, 0, off & 0xFF, off >> 8]))
def stop(ch):
    i2c.writeto_mem(A, 0x06 + 4 * ch, bytes([0, 0, 0, 0x10]))
pulse(0, 1500)
stop(1)
while True:
    time.sleep(1)
